item.title: Data-Driven Optimization for Smart Cities
item.content:encoded:
This special issue of Omega marks the journal's 55th anniversary and focuses on data-driven optimization approaches applicable to smart city challenges. The issue seeks research that combines optimization methodologies with data analytics to address contemporary urban problems and improve city management and services.

Appel publié par Omega. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

item.title: The Politics of Inclusion and Exclusion in Smart Cities
item.content:encoded:
This special issue examines the political dimensions of smart city development, focusing on how technological implementations shape patterns of inclusion and exclusion within urban environments. The call invites research that critically analyzes the social and political consequences of smart city initiatives.
